# CLI reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_docs.py - do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: uv run python scripts/gen_docs.py -->

`hpclab` is the command line of HPC Lab. Every command that reads or changes the ledger goes
through the local controller (autostarted on first use), exactly like the MCP tools, so the CLI,
your coding agent and Python clients always see the same state.

* Default output: the result's summary line, a readable view, then warnings and incomplete-coverage
  notes. `--json` prints the raw result envelope instead (one JSON document on stdout).
* Ids are prefixed by kind (`exp_` experiment, `pln_` plan, `run_` run, `att_` attempt, `op_` operation, `wf_` workflow, `art_` artifact, `ev_` evaluation, `cmp_` comparison, `evb_` evidence, `bud_` reservation, `req_` request, `evt_` event, `ntf_` notification, `prj_` project). Where a command takes an experiment, its name works
  too (the newest experiment of that name). Slurm job ids are not hpclab ids: `hpclab which
  <job id>` maps one back to its run and attempt.
* Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 domain error · 2 usage error · 3 controller unavailable · 4 authentication required.

## Global options

Given before the command, e.g. `hpclab --json runs --experiment <experiment>`.

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print raw result envelopes as JSON. |
| `--home` | text |  | hpclab home directory. (env `HPCLAB_HOME`) |
| `--timeout` | float | `120.0` | Seconds to wait for the controller per call. |
| `--version` | flag |  | Show version. |

## Commands

**Setup and plumbing**

| command | summary |
|---|---|
| [`init`](#hpclab-init) | Create the hpclab home, start the controller, optionally set up the simulator. |
| [`status`](#hpclab-status) | Controller health and anything that needs attention. |
| [`auth`](#hpclab-auth) | Open the SSH master connection hpclab reuses (you complete MFA/Duo in this terminal). |

**Experiments**

| command | summary |
|---|---|
| [`prepare`](#hpclab-prepare) | Freeze code + config into runs and execution plans (nothing is submitted). |
| [`experiments`](#hpclab-experiments) | List experiments, newest first. |
| [`experiment`](#hpclab-experiment) | One experiment: question, plans, run counts by cell code, budget. |
| [`plan`](#hpclab-plan) | A frozen plan: runs, execution plans, validation — or its job script. |

**Runs**

| command | summary |
|---|---|
| [`submit`](#hpclab-submit) | Submit one run, or dispatch a whole plan (smoke gate first, then the matrix). |
| [`runs`](#hpclab-runs) | Runs with their latest attempt: code, scheduler state, time left, progress, health. |
| [`grid`](#hpclab-grid) | Method × seed grid with one code per cell (V R Q S P E F C! U X ?). |
| [`inspect`](#hpclab-inspect) | Everything about one run: attempts (3 state axes + job), pending reason, progress/ETA, health, diagnosis. |
| [`logs`](#hpclab-logs) | Bounded, cursor-based log reads (rotation- and UTF-8-safe). |
| [`cancel`](#hpclab-cancel) | Identity-verified cancel of one attempt (nothing is cancelled on any mismatch). |
| [`recover`](#hpclab-recover) | Diagnosis-driven recovery plan (never submits): prints eligibility and the exact submit command. |
| [`resolve`](#hpclab-resolve) | Human decision for an attempt hpclab cannot settle by itself: an unreconciled or duplicate submission, an unobservable attempt, or a requeue watch holding a run. |
| [`which`](#hpclab-which) | Which run/attempt a Slurm job id belongs to (job ids are not global identities). |
| [`ops`](#hpclab-ops) | A background operation (submit, prepare, cancel, dispatch, collect ...). |

**Results**

| command | summary |
|---|---|
| [`trace`](#hpclab-trace) | The provenance chain behind one table cell: evaluation → artifact digest → attempt → job → run → code → env. |
| [`artifacts`](#hpclab-artifacts) | Declared outputs with size, digest and integrity (not a file browser). |
| [`read`](#hpclab-read) | Bounded, stale-safe read of one artifact (content on stdout, details on stderr). |
| [`collect`](#hpclab-collect) | Extract metrics with a registered evaluator (idempotent; provenance-carrying). |
| [`compare`](#hpclab-compare) | Planned-denominator comparison: mean ± std (n/expected), differences vs baseline, coverage. |
| [`export`](#hpclab-export) | Evidence bundle (Markdown summary, LaTeX, CSV, JSON manifest) written to --out. |
| [`verify`](#hpclab-verify) | Recompute a bundle from the ledger and check manuscript numbers (record consistency, not science). |

**Lab**

| command | summary |
|---|---|
| [`usage`](#hpclab-usage) | GPU-hours by user/partition/state with waste by cause — honest about what Slurm lets you see. |
| [`digest`](#hpclab-digest) | Weekly lab digest (Markdown) from the ledger: progress, failures, GPU-hours, attention items. |
| [`vault`](#hpclab-vault) | Local vault of raw job records (sacct, scripts, env, log head/tail, metrics) per attempt. |
| [`backup`](#hpclab-backup) | Consistent online backup of the ledger (+ vault) to DEST. |
| [`events`](#hpclab-events) | Audit trail: every state change, newest first. |

**Setup**

| [`demo`](#hpclab-demo) | Guided tour on the local simulator: prepare → smoke gate → sweep → failure → diagnosis → recovery → evidence. |
| [`onboard`](#hpclab-onboard) | Inspect a cluster, then run a tiny 1-GPU smoke job end to end and report pass/fail. |

## Command reference

### hpclab init

`hpclab init [OPTIONS]`

Create the hpclab home, start the controller, optionally set up the simulator.

| option | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--sim` / `--no-sim` | flag |  |  | Register the local Slurm simulator as cluster 'sim'. |

### hpclab status

`hpclab status`

Controller health and anything that needs attention.

### hpclab prepare

`hpclab prepare [OPTIONS] [SPEC]`

Freeze code + config into runs and execution plans (nothing is submitted).

| argument | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SPEC` | path |  |  | ExperimentSpec YAML (not needed with --extends/--derive-from). |

| option | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cluster` | text |  |  | Override spec.cluster. |
| `--experiment` | text |  |  | Override spec.name. |
| `--extends` | text |  |  | Experiment to add cells/seeds to. |
| `--add-seeds` | text |  |  | With --extends: seeds to add, e.g. 4,5. |
| `--add` | text |  |  | With --extends: KEY=v1,v2 values to add to a matrix axis. Repeatable. |
| `--derive-from` | text |  |  | Run to derive a new run from. |
| `--set` | text |  |  | With --derive-from: param k=v (repeatable). |
| `--time` | text |  |  | With --derive-from: new time limit. |
| `--mem` | text |  |  | With --derive-from: new memory. |
| `--append-arg` | text |  |  | With --derive-from: extra argv item appended (repeatable). |
| `--recapture-code` | flag |  |  | With --derive-from: snapshot the current code. |
| `--no-remote-checks` | flag |  |  | Skip bounded checks on the cluster. |
| `--override` | text |  |  | CHECK=REASON: accept a blocking finding (recorded). Repeatable. |
| `--all-findings` | flag |  |  | Also list passing checks. |

`hpclab grid [OPTIONS] TARGET`

### hpclab inspect

`hpclab inspect [OPTIONS] REF`

Everything about one run: attempts (3 state axes + job), pending reason, progress/ETA, health, diagnosis.

### hpclab logs

`hpclab logs [OPTIONS] REF`

Bounded, cursor-based log reads (rotation- and UTF-8-safe).

| argument | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REF` | text | yes |  | Attempt id, or run id (its latest attempt). |

| option | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--stderr` | flag |  |  | Read stderr instead of stdout. |
| `--tail`, `-n` | int (1..) |  |  | Only the last N lines. |
| `--follow`, `-f` | flag |  |  | Keep reading new output until the attempt ends. |
| `--cursor` | text |  |  | Continue from a previous read. |
| `--max-bytes` | int |  |  | Bytes per read (<= 65536). |
| `--interval` | float |  | `2.0` | With --follow: seconds between reads at the end of the log. |

### hpclab cancel

`hpclab cancel [OPTIONS] REF`

Identity-verified cancel of one attempt (nothing is cancelled on any mismatch).

| argument | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REF` | text | yes |  | Attempt id, or run id (its active attempt). |

| option | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--checkpoint` | flag |  |  | Ask the job to checkpoint and exit (checkpoint_and_exit runs only). |
| `--reason` | text |  |  | Why (recorded). |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  |  |

### hpclab recover

`hpclab recover [OPTIONS] [REF]`

Diagnosis-driven recovery plan (never submits): prints eligibility and the exact submit command.

| argument | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REF` | text |  |  | Failed attempt id (or run id: its latest attempt). |

| option | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--workflow` | text |  |  | Plan recovery of a workflow's broken cells instead. |
| `--missing` | flag |  |  | With --workflow: every cell without a valid result (default). |
| `--diagnosis` | text |  |  | With --workflow: only cells with this diagnosis code (repeatable). |
| `--strategy` | text |  |  | retry \| resume \| adjust_resources (default: from the diagnosis). |
| `--time` | text |  |  | New time limit (adjust_resources). |
| `--mem` | text |  |  | New memory (adjust_resources). |
| `--partition` | text |  |  | New partition (adjust_resources). |
| `--gpu-type` | text |  |  | New GPU type, e.g. a GPU with more memory after cuda_oom. |
| `--gpus` | int (0..64) |  |  | New GPU count (adjust_resources). |
| `--exclude-nodes` | text |  |  | Nodes to avoid, comma-separated (e.g. after node_fail). |
| `--account` | text |  |  | New Slurm account. |
| `--qos` | text |  |  | New QOS. |
| `--checkpoint` | text |  |  | Checkpoint artifact to resume from (default: newest valid). |

### hpclab resolve

`hpclab resolve [OPTIONS] REF`

Human decision for an attempt hpclab cannot settle by itself: an unreconciled or duplicate
submission, an unobservable attempt, or a requeue watch holding a run.

| argument | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REF` | text | yes |  | Attempt id (or run id). |

| option | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--abandon` | flag |  |  | Give up on the attempt (does not cancel any job). |
| `--bind-job` | text |  |  | Bind this Slurm job id (identity-checked). |
| `--confirm-ended` | flag |  |  | State that a terminal attempt's original job really ended (lifts a requeue watch; re-checked live). |
| `--reason` | text |  |  | Why (required; recorded). |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  |  |

### hpclab controller

`hpclab controller COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Manage the local controller (single writer of the ledger).

| subcommand | summary |
|---|---|
| [`start`](#hpclab-controller-start) | Start the controller in the background (clients also autostart it). |

### hpclab workflow

|---|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `WORKFLOW_ID` | text | yes |  |  |
